// REQ: LANG-2831 LANG-2832 LANG-2833 LANG-2834
// A simple interface
[Exposed=Window]
interface Greeter : EventTarget {
  constructor(optional DOMString name = "world");
  readonly attribute DOMString name;
  /* Greets n times */
  Promise<undefined> greet(unsigned long times);
};
dictionary GreetOptions { boolean loud = false; required DOMString lang; };
